main.description: Running state for an edit lens. Edit lenses translate deltas rather than states, and their internal state evolves with each edit applied. The sequence number orders updates for consistency.

editLens.description: AT-URI of the edit lens this state belongs to.

sourceRecord.description: AT-URI of the current source-side record.

targetRecord.description: AT-URI of the current target-side record.

sequenceNumber.description: Monotonically increasing edit count for ordering and conflict detection.

parentState.description: AT-URI of the previous editLensState record, forming an append-only chain.

objectHash.description: Content hash of the state blob.

blob.description: The edit lens internal state: accumulated context needed to translate future edits.
